title: Austeridad
goal: Explain how austerity and economic adjustment policies responded to the debt crisis and why they were controversial.

items: Explain how austerity and economic adjustment policies responded to the debt crisis and why they were controversial.
Describe the purpose of economic adjustment.
Use vocabulary for austerity, adjustment and cuts.
Explain how governments and institutions responded to the crisis.
Use passive/impersonal «se» to describe policies and measures.
